title: Woman stabbed in chest, hand during overnight altercation in Syracuse
summary: A 22-year-old woman was stabbed in the chest and hand during an overnight altercation in Syracuse early Saturday morning. The victim self-transported to Upstate University Hospital, and Syracuse Police responded to the report around 1:06 a.m. This incident contributes to ongoing crime-data tracking relevant to public safety operations.
